title: Explicitly require console title
description:
To remove dependency on "application flavor" require the console title string to be passed into create_console().
This bled into ws_log, so now each application has a unique title for the debug console.

Why are these all wide string literals?

Because their only use is creating a Windows console, where the API is wide strings.  Do you think the conversion should be done inside the lower layers so that the strings don't need to wide at the higher layers?
Did the UTF-8 to UTF-16 conversion within create_console.
